headlines.text: Anthropic files its S-1 for a Nasdaq IPO targeting a $2 trillion valuation, disclosing roughly $518 billion in long-term compute commitments
Dow closes at 52,361.58, S&P 500 gains 0.7% to 7,676.77 and Nasdaq jumps 0.82% to 26,169.38 as chip stocks rally on Anthropic's IPO filing
Oil eases and stock futures extend gains after Trump rules out striking Iran, unwinding last week's war-risk premium
Fed, ECB and Bank of Japan all deliver rate decisions this week; Fed policymakers lean against an October hike, with markets pricing ~87% odds of a hold at 3.75%-4.00% Wednesday
Big Tech earnings crunch hits this week as Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon report, with investors fixated on runaway AI capital spending
